stories.headline: Bitcoin Core Discloses Details on Three Fixed Vulnerabilities
stories.summary: Advisories detail October 2025 fixes for two medium flaws and a high-severity bug affecting block production.
stories.originalTitle: Bitcoin Core discloses three patched security bugs

stories.headline: Deutsche Bank Begins Crypto Custody for European Institutional Clients
stories.summary: The service supports Bitcoin, Ether, and three stablecoins, alongside a new tokenization agreement with Deutsche Asset Management.
stories.originalTitle: Deutsche Bank starts crypto custody for institutional clients

stories.headline: MSCI Drops Strategy, Metaplanet, and Upexi From Indexes
stories.summary: The index removals take effect after market close on November 30 following MSCI's final review.
stories.originalTitle: MSCI deletes Strategy from indexes at November close

stories.headline: Anthropic Begins Nasdaq IPO Roadshow at $70-$78 Share Price
stories.summary: The company offers 825 million Class A shares under ticker ANT, targeting a valuation up to $1.4 trillion.
stories.originalTitle: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow with $70 to $78 price range on Nasdaq

stories.headline: Banks Commit $270 Million to Joint Stablecoin Project Faro
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs, Citi, Santander, and Deutsche Bank are funding the joint US dollar token initiative.
stories.originalTitle: Banks commit $270 million to Project Faro stablecoin venture

stories.headline: Polish Lawmakers Pass Bill Allowing Crypto Asset Freezes
stories.summary: The Sejm voted 240-202 to approve the legislation, moving the measure to the Polish Senate.
stories.originalTitle: Poland's Lower House Passes Sanctions Bill With Crypto Freezes

stories.headline: Bitmine reports $6.3 billion net loss for fiscal 2026
stories.summary: The company's Form 10-K cited ongoing accounting weaknesses and ether holdings valued $5.4 billion below cost.
stories.originalTitle: Bitmine posts $6.3 billion net loss for fiscal 2026 as ether fell

stories.headline: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over competitor investment
stories.summary: The contract ended after his firm 1789 Capital increased its investment in rival prediction market Polymarket.
stories.originalTitle: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.'s advisory role over Polymarket investment

stories.headline: Kraken Parent Payward Q3 Adjusted EBITDA Drops 66%
stories.summary: Lower trading volumes drove the decline, though non-trading income and global spot market share increased.
stories.originalTitle: Kraken parent Payward posts 66% drop in Q3 adjusted EBITDA
